carpenter.line: I shot a hole in Kathleen Carpenter

carpenter.songTitle: The Tallest Man, the Broadest Shoulders (Part I: The Great Frontier — Part II: Come to Me Only with Playthings Now)
stanza: And when I, and when I call
Invites us to be with her

carpenter.line: But the dream of this poor carpenter
stanza: Two thousand years have passed and gone
But the dream of this poor carpenter
Remains in the hands of you
Remains in the hands of you
